problem.title: Lower Bounds for Seshadri Constants on Minimal Surfaces
problem.statement: If $S$ is a minimal projective surface, $L$ is ample on $S$, and $x\in S$, is $\varepsilon(S,L;x)\geq1/\sqrt[4]{2+|K_S^2|}$?
